Subject: Discovery recap + proposed pilot window (short)

Alex — thanks again for the time earlier. Quick recap from our 30-min discovery:

- Primary objective: reduce inference cost on batch scoring for recommendation pipeline by ~40% while keeping p99 latency under 300ms.
- Current pain: ops overhead from self-hosted endpoints + spiky e2e traffic at month-end.
- Constraints: security team requires SOC2 evidence, procurement prefers monthly billing ramp.
- Success metric for pilot: demonstrate 30-40% token cost reduction + stable 99th percentile latency under 300ms across your largest load window.

Proposed near-term next steps:
1) Pilot scope: 2x model variants (quantized/FP16) on a 2-week pilot against a 10M-token sample we discussed.
2) Kickoff: target Dec 13 start (EOQ runway) — Jordan + Vivek to run onboarding; Zenith to provide access + sample dataset.
3) Procurement: I can share a short SOW draft and simplified pricing for pilot (monthly billing).

I attached a short Discovery-Recap (one pager) and a checklist of what we'd need to start. Can you confirm: (a) is Dec 13 still feasible for your team, and (b) is procurement the blocker or is it security signoff?

Thanks — happy to jump on a 15-min follow-up if helpful.

Attachments: Discovery-Recap.pdf (PDF)
